== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
New page, drafted from old Players Committee forum posts.

=== Sources used ===
* Players Committee forum topic 4383, "California/Alderaan Regional - Who's going?", posts 59728, 59712, 60505, 60502, 59861, 59713, 59714, 59781, 60520, 60649, 60657, 60625, 60676, 60640, 60642 (refs <code>pcf-4383-…</code>).
* Players Committee 2004/2005 events listing (ref <code>pc-events05</code>, reused from [[List of SWCCG tournaments]]).

=== Missing data ===
* The venue is not named in the topic. Eudemonia is named only as the shop where WARS packs would be bought on the day; the promotion went through a UC Berkeley group.
* The runner-up is not named. Second place played Quiet Mining Colony / Hunt Down; a player named Philip went 3–0 with Hunt Down; and [[Philip Green]] holds the second Day 2 bye. That points to Philip Green as runner-up, but no post says so, so the table leaves the name blank.
* Third place and the full standings are not in the captured topic (Sanders promised a round-by-round breakdown).
* Real names of PhataLerror (signs "Dave") and l000needles are not given.
* The final entry fee is not confirmed; Sanders only expected it to rise to $10.

=== Possibly faulty data ===
* PhataLerror spells the name "Clayton Atkins"; Nordstrom (who drove in with him) writes "Clayton Atkin", the existing page title.

=== Marginal cuts ===
* PhataLerror's game-by-game report: only fourth place, the decks, the Imperial Decree ruling and his prizes were used.
* [[Geoff Bowman]] (RedV) planned to come but could not; left out.

=== Build notes ===
* Title follows the World Championship season naming of [[2005 Endor Regional]] and the [[List of SWCCG tournaments]] row "Alderaan Regional" under 2005.
* Deck archetype names are given as posted and not linked to objective pages, except where the name is an exact card title.
